newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hoechst plans to quit generic drugs.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst plans to quit generic drugs.

text.p: Hoechst AG plans to stop producing generic drugs, the weekly news magazine Focus reported.
A spokesman, reached on Sunday, said the company does not comment on rumors or speculation.
The magazine said Hoechst was preparing to sell the Rugby Group, a subsidiary of Hoechst Marion Russel, and one of the leading generic drugs producers in the U.S.
Hoechst is negotiating the sale with a major U.S. competitor, Focus said.
It may also be getting ready to put subsidiaries Copley Pharmaceuticals and Arthur H. Cox & Co. on the block, it said.
